info.name: Docusign Gets a list of room folders accessible to the current user.

params.name: roomId
params.description: The ID of the room from which to retrieve folders.

params.name: startPosition
params.description: The starting zero-based index position of the results set. When this property is used as a query parameter, the default value is `0`.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of results. When this property is used as a request parameter specifying the number of results to return, the value must be a number between `1` and `100` (default).

params.name: accountId
params.description: The globally unique identifier (GUID) for the account.

items.docs: Gets a list of room folders in the specified room that are accessible to the current user.
